name: cleanup_purge_apps

module_summary: macOS disk reclamation: estimate first, then purge caches by category behind an explicit confirmation. Merges the old `clean.sh` estimator with the unguarded cache removals that used to live in `ai.sh`.

module_summary: Interactive shell baseline: locale, editor/pager, vi keybindings, unlimited shared history, and a few generic command helpers.
describe: Serve the current directory over HTTP. Salvaged from rhoit/rho.sh, whose other entries all shadowed real binaries and were retired.

name: shell_setup_history
module_summary: Interactive shell baseline: locale, editor/pager, vi keybindings, unlimited shared history, and a few generic command helpers.
describe: Configure effectively unlimited, timestamped, cross-session shell history for whichever shell is running. Idempotent — safe to call again after re-sourcing.

name: shell_time_command
module_summary: Interactive shell baseline: locale, editor/pager, vi keybindings, unlimited shared history, and a few generic command helpers.
describe: Time a command in whole seconds without needing bc or GNU date.

name: ssh_generate_host_config
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Regenerate the ssh config fragment for one AWS account/region using easyssh, then rebuild ~/.ssh/config. Credentials are read from ~/.aws/keys/<account>, which must be a regular file.
danger: Sources ~/.aws/keys/<account> into the current shell and replaces $SSH_CONFIG_D/<account>-<region>.config, then runs ssh_refresh_config.

name: ssh_generate_key
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Generate a passphrase-less 4096-bit RSA keypair for an application under $SSH_KEYGEN_OUT_DIR (default ~/.ssh/generated, mode 700).
danger: Writes an unencrypted private key to disk. Refuses to overwrite an existing key of the same name.

name: ssh_generate_keys_all
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Generate a keypair for every name in $APPLICATION_LIST.
danger: See ssh_generate_key.

name: ssh_list_hosts
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Print the Host names of production app/worker entries in ~/.ssh/config.

name: ssh_list_hosts_matching
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Print production hosts whose name matches a pattern.

name: ssh_refresh_config
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Rebuild ~/.ssh/config from the fragments in $SSH_CONFIG_D. The previous config is kept as a timestamped backup next to it, so a mistaken run is always recoverable. Explicit command only — this is never run automatically.
danger: Replaces ~/.ssh/config. Hand edits made directly to that file are lost; put them in $SSH_CONFIG_D/*.config instead. A backup is written to ~/.ssh/config.<timestamp>.bak first.

name: ssh_start_x2x
module_summary: SSH config assembly from ~/.ssh/config.d, host listing, key generation, and EasySSH-driven inventory refresh.
describe: Share this machine's keyboard and mouse with a remote X display over ssh, using x2x.

name: text_copy_2fa_code
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Pick a 2FA account with fzf and copy its current code to the clipboard.

name: text_copy_and_announce
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Copy text to the clipboard and announce it with a talking cow. Degrades to cowsay, then to a plain echo.

name: text_decode_base64
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Base64-decode arguments, or stdin when called with none.

name: text_encode_base64
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Base64-encode arguments, or stdin when called with none. Always one line, no wrapping, on both BSD and GNU base64.

name: text_grep_env
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Grep the environment case-insensitively. With no argument it prints the whole environment.

name: text_load_env_file
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Export every variable defined in a dotenv file. Handles values that contain spaces, '=', '#' or quotes — the old `export $(sed ... | xargs)` mangled all of those.

name: text_make_qrcode
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Render text as a QR code directly in the terminal.

name: text_pretty_json
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Pretty print JSON from a file or stdin. Uses jq when available and falls back to python3's json.tool.

name: text_random_password
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Generate a random password of the given length. Prints it by default; with --copy it goes to the clipboard and is never echoed.

name: text_show_binary
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Print the 8-bit binary representation of every character in the given text, one character per line.

name: text_show_binary_inline
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Print the binary for some text as a single space-separated line, followed by the original text.

name: text_split_lines
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Split comma-separated values onto one line each.

name: text_split_to_json_array
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Turn space-separated words into a JSON array of strings, ready to paste into a config file.

name: text_unload_env_file
module_summary: Text and string plumbing: base64, splitting, binary dumps, JSON pretty printing, QR codes, and .env file handling.
describe: Unset every variable named in a dotenv file.

name: tls_gen_self_signed
module_summary: OpenSSL helpers: inspect a certificate file, inspect a live endpoint, and generate self-signed certificates for local testing.
describe: Generate a self-signed certificate, its key, and a concatenated PEM bundle (the form mongod and some proxies want) into a directory. With no output directory it creates a fresh private temp dir and prints the path. Never changes your working directory.

name: tls_get_remote_info
module_summary: OpenSSL helpers: inspect a certificate file, inspect a live endpoint, and generate self-signed certificates for local testing.
describe: Print the notBefore/notAfter dates of the certificate a TLS server is currently presenting. SNI name and connect host are separate so you can test a specific backend behind a load balancer.

name: tls_show_cert
module_summary: OpenSSL helpers: inspect a certificate file, inspect a live endpoint, and generate self-signed certificates for local testing.
describe: Print a certificate file in full human-readable form: subject, issuer, validity window, SANs, key usage, signature algorithm.
